an3.102:3.3: If a mendicant dedicated to the higher mind focuses solely on the basis of immersion, it’s likely their mind will incline to laziness.
an3.102:3.4: If they focus solely on the basis of exertion, it’s likely their mind will incline to restlessness.
an3.102:3.5: If they focus solely on the basis of equanimity, it’s likely their mind won’t properly become immersed in samādhi for the ending of defilements.
